description: This file defines a class ScheduleMessageModal for automating interactions with a scheduling message modal in a web UI, using Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for selecting dates and times, and scheduling messages.

classes.name: ScheduleMessageModal
classes.description: A class encapsulating interactions with the schedule message modal component in the UI.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the modal container is visible.

methods.name: getDaySuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix ('st', 'nd', 'rd', 'th') for a given day number.

methods.name: dateLocator
methods.description: Constructs a locator for a specific date button based on day, month, and day of week.

methods.name: selectDate
methods.description: Selects a date in the modal, optionally offset by days from today.

methods.name: selectTime
methods.description: Selects a time option in the modal based on index.

methods.name: scheduleMessage
methods.description: Coordinates the process of scheduling a message by selecting date and time, then clicking schedule.
